description: This plot illustrates the "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3". The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. There are three lines plotted, none of which use markers. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003", begins at approximately 0.0 at Layer 0 and maintains a steady trend near 0.0 across the entire x-axis, ending at approximately 0.0. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126", starts at a peak of approximately 0.8 at Layer 0, declines sharply to roughly 0.4 by Layer 2, and continues to decrease until it reaches near 0.0 around Layer 10; it then remains near 0.0, with a minor peak of approximately 0.05 around Layer 21, before ending near 0.0. The green dash-dot line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080", also begins at approximately 0.8 at Layer 0, exhibits a sharp decline to roughly 0.2 by Layer 2, and gradually decreases to near 0.0 by Layer 10, maintaining this steady value through the end of the x-axis.
